column3: NASB renders the comparisons with “The more … The more” and “The richer … The better.”
“Slippery” is rendered “faithless,” and “be held guilty” “bear their guilt”; NASB supplies “The LORD” for “he.”
“Words” is rendered “mere words”; “swearing an oath of falsehood” is rendered “worthless oaths”; “justice” is rendered “judgment.”
“Heifers” (plural) is rendered “calf,” and “pagan priests” “idolatrous priests”; “tremble” is rendered “cry out,” and “gone into exile” “departed.”
“Also it” is rendered “The thing itself”; “shame Ephraim will seize” is rendered “Ephraim will be seized with shame.”
“High places of wickedness” is rendered “high places of Aven,” keeping the word as a name.
“Since” is rendered “From”; “they have remained” is rendered “There they stand!”; NASB renders the second half as a question.
“At my desire” is rendered “When it is My desire”; “two iniquities” is rendered “double guilt.”
“I passed over the goodness of its neck” is rendered “I will come over her fair neck with a yoke”; NASB supplies “with a yoke.”
“To a mouth of loyalty” is rendered “in accordance with kindness”; “unplowed ground” is rendered “fallow ground.”
“Like the devastation of Shalman Beth Arbel” is rendered “As Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel”; “mother” is rendered “mothers.”
“Someone will do” is rendered “it will be done,” and “the evil of your wickedness” “your great wickedness”; “certainly destroyed” is rendered “completely cut off.”
